35: Cortech SafeBin Trash Receptacle
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-35-safebin-trash-receptacle
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/safebin/
Spec sheets: 35, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech SafeBin Lockable Trash Receptacle – 35
Current H1: Cortech Safebin Trash Receptacle
Subtitle: Lockable Molded Trash Receptacle with a Tamper-Resistant Chute and a 35-Gallon Inner Container
Current subtitle: Cortech 35BK Safebin Trash Receptacle
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech SafeBin Lockable Trash Receptacle is a molded trash receptacle for behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. Its tamper-resistant waste chute keeps the liner and discarded items out of reach, and an integrated lock with a master key keeps the bin closed.
The SafeBin is rotationally molded without metal hinges, bolts to the floor or wall, and holds a 35-gallon inner container that can be used with or without trash liners. It is rated for outdoor use.
Construction: Rotationally molded, with no metal hinges
Capacity: 35-gallon inner container, for use with or without trash liners
Waste Chute: Tamper-resistant chute prevents access to the liner and discarded items
Lock: Integrated lock with master key
Mounting: Bolts to the floor or wall
Cleaning: Slightly sloped bottom interior for easy cleaning and drainage
Weight: 115 lbs
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Colors: Black top with a body in Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 10-year warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
35 – SafeBin: Body color of your choice with a black top
Installation and Options
Floor or Wall Mounting: Bolt to the floor or wall through four pilot holes; concrete anchors, hex bolts, and washers are included; see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The SafeBin suits secure areas where staff need to keep trash and liners out of residents’ reach.
Typical applications include:
Housing units, dayrooms, and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Patient areas in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Kitchens and other secure areas that need a locked trash receptacle
Explore Anchortex's Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collections for more trash receptacles and sanitation supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Can Dollies: Cobra Can dollies in two sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
Secure Waste Bins: The lockable SafeBin with a 35-gallon inner container
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (59 characters): Cortech SafeBin Lockable Trash Receptacle - 35 at Anchortex
Meta description (155 characters): Shop the Cortech SafeBin. A lockable molded trash receptacle with a tamper-resistant chute and a 35-gallon inner container that bolts to the floor or wall.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is a new section for the Cobra Can, Cobra Mini Can, can dolly, and Kangaroo Cart pages. It is the same on each of these pages. I added a "Secure Waste Bins" line for the SafeBin. Would you like it added to the other facilities maintenance pages too?
H1: Cortech writes "SafeBin" with a capital B. I added "Lockable" and the model number 35.
Weight: your variant is set to 115 lbs, which matches the Cortech spec sheet.
Dimensions: the Cortech spec sheet does not give dimensions, so I left them out.
Variant name: your variant is "35_BK - Safebin." Cortech model numbers are 35 plus the body color code plus BK (black top), for example 35AQBK. Your variant has no color option. How do customers choose a body color?
Colors: your current page lists 12 body colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Mounting hardware: the Cortech installation instructions say the concrete anchors, hex bolts, and washers are included.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says the SafeBin is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Collection links: the SafeBin is in your Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Kitchen and Food Service collections, so I linked those two.
I left out "Patent Pending."
Product images: the page has four images, including a color chart. The Cortech product page has two SafeBin photos (closed and with the door open). Would you like me to add them?
